Find in Files uses `is_ascii_identifier_char` for whole words and has different logic to GDScript symbols which seem to use `is_unicode_identifier_continue`.
Rather than having this on the ScriptEditor, `symbol_rename` could be stored on the Find in Files finder or panel.
Any example when it makes difference? (for easier testing)

It happens when a word you are searching for is next to non-ascii characters. So for example, if you search for `my_var` on the text `my_var테스트`, it will match when it shouldn't.

I think it should be fine to change FindInFiles to use unicode, lots of other ascii only cases were changed.

The find bar uses `!is_symbol()` (in `TextEdit::search`), which might be good enough for what we want?
Opened a separate fix, since it's not really related: #121385
